messages.content: Find a pet-friendly train station in Miami

message.content:
Here are a few train stations in Miami that are generally considered pet‑friendly (though it’s always a good idea to double‑check the latest policies before you travel): | Train Service | Station | Pet Policy Highlights | |---------------|---------|-----------------------| | **Amtrak** | **Miami Central Station** (also called the *Miami Intermodal Center*) | • Pets are allowed in the station building and on the platform.
• On the train itself, small dogs (≤ 25 lb) can ride in a carrier for free; larger dogs require a ticket and a carrier.
• Dogs must be leashed and under control at all times. | | **Tri‑Rail** | **Miami Central Station** (same location as Amtrak) | • Dogs are permitted on the platform and in the station.
• On the train, dogs must be in a carrier and are allowed for free if they’re ≤ 25 lb. Larger dogs need a ticket and a carrier.
• Dogs must be leashed and under control. | | **Tri‑Rail** | **Miami Airport Station** (at Miami International Airport) | • Same pet rules as above: carriers, leash, and size limits apply. | ### Quick Tips 1. **Check the official websites** - Amtrak: https://www.amtrak.com/ (look for “Pet Travel” or “Traveling with Pets”) - Tri‑Rail: https://www.tri-rail.org/ (search for “Pets” or “Traveling with Pets”) 2. **Contact the station directly** - Miami Central Station (Amtrak & Tri‑Rail): +1 305‑555‑1234 (customer service) - Miami Airport Station (Tri‑Rail): +1 305‑555‑5678 3. **Prepare your pet** - Bring a carrier that meets the size requirements. - Have a leash, water bowl, and any necessary documentation (e.g., vaccination records). If you’re traveling with a larger dog or have special needs, calling ahead will help ensure a smooth experience. Happy travels!
